label_method: Separate agent authors gold from actual generated text and written contract, followed by independent source review. No extractor or normalizer may generate the answers.

future_run_policy.tuning: No prompt or runtime change while evaluating this set; if used to tune, reclassify as development.
future_run_policy.model_input: Only report text, never seeds or gold; questionnaires remain empty.
metrics: evidence validity separately from semantic correctness
future_run_policy.evidence_policy: A verified harmless skipped-sentence quote may be accepted only in a separately recorded, source-bound review-assisted replay; preserve raw outputs and original strict metrics. It is not automatically a factual error. Invented facts, dropped negations, changed timing, contradictions, and wrong symptom attribution are not waived.
future_run_policy.failures: Preserve all failures and denominators; no retry or cherry-picking.

limitations: Deliberately targeted small synthetic sample, not random patient data.
Generation and extraction may use the same model family.
Authors know scenario categories; only extraction prompts/runtime are frozen before text generation.
Coverage omits correction chains, multi-day allocation, time-zone boundary changes, and hypothetical reports.
No model accuracy is measured during data preparation.
